metrics.label: Worst of F1, F2 error vs target
Worst of F1, F2 error vs target

failure_cause: MECHANISM: the profile model fits (loss 2.75) but realizing it with a finite number of weak 1 cm posts raises the loss to 5.23 on Tier 0 and the full-wave field to 5.46 (incoherent residue; see design_study.extinction); the clap spectrum is the largest of the three ablated constraints (numbers below), none of which explains the realized error; Tier 1 formant_err_pct = n/a (judge returned no value) vs <= 10.0 (judge floor on a perfect echo 10.3); Tier 0 of the same posts: f2_err_pct 2.16, f2_hz 1.18e+03, f1_target_hz 744, f2_target_hz 1.2e+03; stretch measured -0.190 % (applied -0.195 %, Tier1-vs-Tier0 corr after stretch 0.758), tier gap -0.5032293491911446 dB; Tier 1 spectrogram loss 5.456; realization (Tier 0, ah): continuous profile echo loss 2.364 vs best realized 5.145 ((i) sampling, 1499 posts): the discrete posts add more error than the profile's own fit; count sweep (quantile, Tier 0, ah): 1 cm x 1500: 5.28, 1 cm x 4975: 4.48, 1 cm x 11742: 5.38, 4 cm x 1497: 4.44, 4 cm x 3705: 4.61, 4 cm x 6240: 4.97; ablations (Tier 0 profile model, loss 500-4000 Hz): baseline 2.380, ceiling 0.479; removing alone: clap spectrum +1.472, positivity +0.192, small-post scattering +0.857; restoring alone onto the ceiling: clap spectrum +1.061, positivity -0.065, small-post scattering +0.157; largest single cost: clap spectrum

judge_floor.note: metrics of target * clap (band-limited): the floor set by the judge and the clap, not the design

caveats: 1 cm and 2 cm posts: forward/side scattering off the analytic cylinder at the 4 kHz grid (1 cm forward 1.04 dB, 90-degree 1.77 dB; 2 cm forward 1.47 dB, 90-degree 0.43 dB) (backscatter within 1 dB; cause measured at the 4 kHz grid: dipole part ~10 % strong for sub-cell posts); effect on dense-field echoes is not bounded; shadowing and multiple scattering are checked by self-convergence only, not against an exact solution

1 cm and 2 cm posts: forward/side scattering off the analytic cylinder at the 2.5 kHz grid (1 cm forward 2.61 dB, 90-degree 0.51 dB; 2 cm forward 1.73 dB, 90-degree 1.65 dB) (backscatter within 1 dB; cause measured at the 4 kHz grid: dipole part ~10 % strong for sub-cell posts); effect on dense-field echoes is not bounded; shadowing and multiple scattering are checked by self-convergence only, not against an exact solution
1 cm posts at the 2.5 kHz grid (r/dx 0.73) pass backscatter at the 3 fixed offsets only: below the calibrated sub-cell range (area factor clamped), no held-out offsets checked there
1 cm posts fail backscatter at the 2 kHz grid: not validated there

stretch.definition: Tier 1 echo(t) ~ Tier 0 echo of the same posts at t (1 + eps_measured) (the medium's stretch); ranges scaled by 1 + eps_applied; timing residual = (1 + eps_measured) / (1 + eps_applied) - 1; refit after each Tier 1 run

robustness_not_run_reason: each speed-of-sound or jitter case is one more full Tier 1 solve (~10 min under the machine-wide lock); stage 4's budget is 7 solves in total, spent on the designs

predicted.model: 4.343 x 2 int n_A sigma drho; sigma = total scattering width (partial waves); lateral width = occupied post extent per 0.5 m range bin; single-scattering estimate

full_wedge_level.label: unverified single-scattering estimate (Tier 0, no extinction); ring populations scaled to the full +-20 deg wedge at the same areal density

ablations.model: E_k = irfft(C_k * W * profile_transfer(profile)) (2D, Tier 0 profile model, on-axis)

ablations.flat_clap: ideal flat-spectrum clap: band-limited delta 500-4000 Hz, peak 1 (one shape, all 5 rows identical)
ablations.signed: signed reflectivity allowed (identity parameterization instead of softplus)
ablations.flat_scatter: frequency-flat scatterers: transfer divided by |T_1cm(f)| / |T_1cm(2.5 kHz)|

ablations.selection: per combination: lower final EchoLoss (500-4000 Hz) of two inits; judges informational only

realization_study.selection: lowest mean Tier 0 spectrogram loss under 1 and 2 mm radial jitter (3 seeds); judges info only

count_sweep.note: Tier 0 ignores multiple scattering: high fill rows are optimistic (stage 1: 4 cm at 2.3 % fill had nothing in common with Tier 1)
